reviews.title: Amazing Buy For the Price
reviews.comment: The AsiaHorse COSMIQ 120mm case fan delivers a solid mix of performance and aesthetics, especially if you’re building or upgrading a PC on a budget but still want a clean-looking setup. The RGB lighting is surprisingly vibrant and adds a nice visual touch through a tempered glass case without looking overly flashy or cheap. In terms of cooling, the fan does a respectable job improving airflow, especially when used as part of a multi-fan setup. It keeps internal temperatures stable during gaming and general workloads, and noise levels stay fairly controlled at normal speeds. It’s not the quietest premium fan on the market, but it strikes a reasonable balance between airflow and sound. Installation is straightforward, and the build quality feels decent for the price point. The frame is sturdy enough, and the cables are manageable, though not as refined as higher-end brands. Syncing the RGB with common motherboard software worked without much hassle in my case. Overall, this is a good value option if you want decent cooling performance with attractive lighting without spending premium-tier money. It’s best suited for budget-to-midrange builds where aesthetics still matter but cost efficiency is a priority.
reviews.author: Johnnyb

reviews.title: Great RGB colors, quiet, and keep things cool.
reviews.comment: Very quiet and great quality! The control is easy, I use the fam control app from GitHub to control my fans and make custom fan curves. Daisy chaining these work great and look extremely clean and function well. The cable length is long, too long for my use case but sufficient for any you could need. They fit well and aren’t too thick, and the RGB is beautiful looking
reviews.author: Austin

reviews.title: A Great Budget Alternative To The Lian Li Infinity Fans
reviews.comment: Im running 11 of these fans in a Lian Li Vision Compact ..3 Forward (Exhaust)on the mesh top..3 Reverse(Intake)on the bottom ..3 Reverse(Intake) on the 360mm rad..2 Forward(Exhaust) at the Rear.They move alot of air.They are surprisingly quiet for 11 fans and the LEDs are bright. They are an affordable alternative to the Lian Li Infinity.They dont look as slick as the Lian Li fans but when you factor in cost..they perform and look great. Im very pleased. If spending $500 on case fans isn't in your budget..The Cosmiq are the way to go!

reviews.title: Basically cheap LIAN LI fans
reviews.comment: Great look and easy to install and work great in a fan hub and are super quiet when the fan curve is properly adjusted. And work perfectly with my asus fan controller and rgb software. Overall they are a 10/10 for the price

reviews.title: Great Product & Value!
reviews.comment: The value of these fans are well above their worth. I was originally sent incorrect facings fans, I submitted a return request and customer service was quick in getting the correct product to me for my new build. Great customer service, value, and product. I love that these fans daisy chain, they made installation extremely simple. Will definitely buy from them again and highly recommend them to anyone.
